rules.prepare:
if [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" = "tools" ]; then NCURSESW_INCLUDE_DIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/include" else NCURSESW_INCLUDE_DIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/include/ncursesw" fi
CONFARGS=" --prefix=$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX \ --host=$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE \ --includedir=$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/include \ --sysconfdir=/etc \ --enable-echo \ --enable-const \ --enable-pc-files \ --enable-symlinks \ --disable-termcap \ --disable-rpath \ --with-default-terminfo-dir=/etc/terminfo \ --with-terminfo-dirs=/etc/terminfo:$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/terminfo:$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/terminfo \ --with-pkg-config-libdir=$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/pkgconfig \ --with-ticlib=tic \ --with-termlib=tinfo \ --with-versioned-syms \ --with-xterm-kbs=del \ --with-shared \ --with-progs \ --without-profile \ --without-debug \ --without-ada \ --without-tests \ --disable-stripping "
CONFARGS_LEGACY=" --with-abi-version=5 \ --disable-lp64 \ --with-chtype=long \ --with-mmask-t=long \ --disable-overwrite \ --without-cxx-binding \ --without-normal "
CONFAGS_WCHAR=" --enable-widec \ --with-ncursesw \ --includedir=$NCURSESW_INCLUDE_DIR "
export cf_cv_type_of_bool=unsigned char export cf_cv_working_poll=yes
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" mkdir -p curses5 && cd curses5 "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure" $CONFARGS $CONFARGS_LEGACY
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" mkdir -p curses5w && cd curses5w "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure" $CONFARGS $CONFARGS_LEGACY $CONFAGS_WCHAR
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" mkdir -p curses6 && cd curses6 "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure" $CONFARGS
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" mkdir -p curses6w && cd curses6w "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure" $CONFARGS $CONFAGS_WCHAR
rules.build: for VARIANT in curses5 curses5w curses6 curses6w; do cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/$VARIANT" make -j"$AELTRA_PARALLEL_JOBS" done
rules.install:
BADTERMINFO="5/5250 f/fbterm i/iterm i/iterm-am i/iterm-color j/jfbterm k/kon k/kon2 l/linux-5250 s/stterm s/stterm-256color"
LIBTERMINFOFILES="a/ansi c/cons25 c/cons25-debian c/cygwin d/dumb h/hurd l/linux m/mach m/mach-bold m/mach-color m/mach-gnu m/mach-gnu-color p/pcansi r/rxvt r/rxvt-m r/rxvt-basic r/rxvt-unicode s/screen s/screen-bce s/screen-s s/screen-w s/sun v/vt100 v/vt102 v/vt220 v/vt52 x/xterm x/xterm-debian x/xterm-xfree86 x/xterm-color x/xterm-mono x/xterm-r5 x/xterm-r6 x/xterm-vt220 x/xterm-256color s/screen-256color s/screen-256color-bce w/wsvt25 w/wsvt25m E/Eterm E/Eterm-color"
for VARIANT in curses5 curses5w curses6 curses6w; do cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/$VARIANT" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install done
# Debian uses a linker script instead of a symlink. rm -f "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/libtermcap.so" echo "GROUP( libtinfo.so )" > "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/libtermcap.so" ln -sf libtinfo.a "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/libtermcap.a"
# Always add -ltinfo when linking with -lncurses or -lnursesw rm -f "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/libncurses.so" echo "INPUT(libncurses.so.6 -ltinfo)" > "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/libncurses.so" rm -f "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/libncursesw.so" echo "INPUT(libncursesw.so.6 -ltinfo)" > "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/libncursesw.so"
# Move terminfo files to the right place. mv "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/etc/terminfo" "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/terminfo"
# Remove blacklisted terminal types and other stuff we don't install cd "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/terminfo" && rm -f $BADTERMINFO && cd -
# Move ncurses-base terminfo entries to /lib/terminfo. for f in $LIBTERMINFOFILES; do dir="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/terminfo/$(dirname $f)" mkdir -p "$dir" if [ -f "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/terminfo/$f" ]; then mv "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/terminfo/$f" "$dir" fi done
# Create an empty /etc/terminfo for the sysadmin. mkdir -p "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/etc/terminfo"
# Symlinks libcurses.a and libcurses.so seem to be missing when prefix != /usr if [ ! -e "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/libcurses.a" ]; then ln -sf libncurses.a \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/libcurses.a" fi if [ ! -e "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/libcurses.so" ]; then ln -sf libncurses.so \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/libcurses.so" fi
# Build system ignores includedir directive when prefix != /usr if [ -d "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/include/ncurses" ]; then mv "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/include/ncurses/"* \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/include" rmdir "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/include/ncurses/" sed -i 's@ncurses/@@g' "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/include/"*.h fi
